title: Little dragon holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M52 38 Q56 50 54 62' stroke='#9fe8ff' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='26' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#ff5a86'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='26' rx='11' ry='13' fill='none' stroke='#ffb3c8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='21' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#ffd0dd' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M50 39 L54 39 L52 43 Z' fill='#ff5a86' stroke='#ffb3c8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M24 76 Q14 80 12 70 Q11 62 18 64 Q14 70 20 72 Q26 72 28 70 Z' fill='#3fbf6a' stroke='#9af0b8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- back leg -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='80' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#2f9e56'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='64' rx='15' ry='17' fill='#3fbf6a'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='60' rx='9' ry='10' fill='#b6f5c8'/>
  <!-- front leg -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='80' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#3fbf6a'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='80' rx='7' ry='6' fill='none'/>
  <!-- arm holding string -->
  <path d='M54 62 Q58 60 55 56' stroke='#3fbf6a' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='56' r='2.5' fill='#b6f5c8'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='12' fill='#3fbf6a'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='46' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#3fbf6a'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='46' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#b6f5c8'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='45' r='1.2' fill='#2f9e56'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='39' r='3.5' fill='#e8fff0'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='39' r='2' fill='#1a5c33'/>
  <circle cx='51.6' cy='38' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <path d='M44 33 Q42 26 46 28 Q46 31 47 33 Z' fill='#ffcf4d' stroke='#fff0b8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M54 32 Q56 25 58 28 Q57 31 56 33 Z' fill='#ffcf4d' stroke='#fff0b8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- back spikes -->
  <path d='M33 55 L28 52 L33 61 Z' fill='#ffcf4d'/>
  <path d='M31 66 L26 65 L32 71 Z' fill='#ffcf4d'/>
  <!-- wing -->
  <path d='M36 56 Q26 46 30 58 Q26 56 32 66 Z' fill='#7be09a' stroke='#b6f5c8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- belly shine -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='58' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#e0ffe8' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
